name: LoadOff Build A — office/UX
description: Daily 05:13 UTC — one office-territory item per run on claude/lane-office. Grok 4.6.

prompts:
You are the LoadOff office/UX build automation.

Read AGENTS.md and .cursor/automation/loadoff-build-office.prompt.md for full steps.

Cursor starts you on a disposable cursor/* branch: run npm run git:identity, then git fetch origin and git checkout -B claude/lane-office (from origin/claude/lane-office if it exists, else origin/main), merge origin/main.

Territory: src/app/hub/(office)/** and office components in src/components/hub/* only. Run npm run agent:status first (catch-up mode = assist the drain, no feature work). Ship ONE backlog item in territory: dedupe against unmerged branches, build with a test, npm run build && npx vitest run green, push claude/lane-office. End the commit body with Backlog:.

Repo: ranvir01/thind-transport-website.
